name: Chaotic Academia

influenced_by: dark academia (as a messier, more maximalist counterpart)

reacts_against: dark academia's tidy, curated moodiness, embracing visible mess and eccentric clutter instead.

wiki_facts.key_motifs: illegible notes, disorganized desks, dusty records, messy handwriting, ragged fabrics, torn and stained pages
wiki_facts.key_colours: White, beige, gray, woody brown, tan
wiki_facts.key_values: Disorganization,  philosophy, curiosity, learning, rejection of elitism, niche subjects

findings: dark — about 61% of the measured color across 6 wiki photos is below mid-lightness
mostly muted — about 83% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from the Aesthetics Wiki images as photographed and displayed on screen; actual materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
